en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from one of his companions, from Ibrahim Bin Abu Al Balaad, from Ali Bin Al Mugheira, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘From the misery of the life is the evil ride’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from certain persons of his people from Ibrahim ibn abu al-Balad from Ali ibn al-Mughirah who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
It is a misfortune in life to have a bad stumper.’”
